title: Every notification announcement lands in exactly one live region and the two wrappers never carry the same body simultaneously
asA: screen-reader user of a shipped rcf-lite application
iWant: each announcement to reach me on exactly one queue (polite for informational, assertive for error), never on both
soThat: the assistive-technology announcement contract stays clean and I do not hear the same message twice from two queues

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given any surfaced notification (toast or centre), the notification's body text appears inside exactly one of `[data-live-region="polite"]` or `[data-live-region="assertive"]` at any moment; a notification whose body appears in both wrappers, or a notification whose body appears in the wrong wrapper for its priority (informational text in the assertive wrapper, or error text in the polite wrapper), is a defect. The pack asserts this by scanning both wrappers after each emission and confirming disjoint content.
acceptanceCriteria.when: both live-region wrappers are read simultaneously
acceptanceCriteria.then: the body text appears in exactly one wrapper
